title: qgb external proposal (Pattern B, Phase 2 Step 2.5)
description: A proposal document produced OUTSIDE qgb (typically by an external LLM tool reading the output of 'qgb design-stages propose-context') and consumed by 'qgb design-stages adopt'. The only proposal_type Phase 2 understands is 'policy_stages': stages[] declaratively REPLACES policy.json#stages in full. The schema deliberately has no room for req-meta or contract content (P9): those are edited via 'qgb patch' / domain edit commands. Root additionalProperties is false because this is an external-input boundary — unknown keys are more likely typos or smuggled content than extensions (NF-007).

schema_version.description: Proposal document schema version. The schema only constrains the shape; qgb code enforces the supported set and rejects others with AdoptError(reason=unsupported_schema_version), so future versions fail with a precise reason instead of a generic schema error.

proposal_type.description: What this proposal replaces. Phase 2 supports exactly 'policy_stages'. Like schema_version, the supported set is enforced in code (AdoptError reason=unsupported_proposal_type) to keep the reason machine-distinguishable.

policy_id.description: Optional new policy_id. When absent, the current policy.json's policy_id is preserved.

source_metadata.description: Free-form provenance carried verbatim into the adopt result JSON (P7: auditors can trace what generated the proposal). qgb never interprets these values as instructions (P8/NF-007).

stages.description: Full replacement for policy.json#stages. Item shape mirrors policy.schema.json#stages items; uniqueness of ids and DAG-ness of depends_on are enforced by the adopt-time preflight, not here.
